notes: UX-01 Batch 3 hotfix 2 - business call confirmed 'Hồ sơ đánh giá áp dụng cho mọi tài khoản trừ Admin', so a manager-role account with no Checklist permission grant (session.role='manager', no grant - confirmed by trace: requireRoles(['manager']) in phf-url-router.js already proves this account class exists and can reach /ql/checklist) must get a working self-view Assessment Profile at /ql/checklist/ho-so-danh-gia too, not just 'no dead end' like hotfix 1 left it - backend already supports this (self-view never required a grant). Replaced the routeRole==='learner'-only gate from hotfix 1 with 4 shared helpers - checklistHasManagementAccess/checklistManagerWorkspaceActive/isChecklistPersonalExperience/checklistPersonalBasePath - so 'personal experience' (2 tabs, no picker, self-only) now correctly covers both learner AND manager-without-grant, while a manager WITH a grant is unaffected (still routed into the existing manager workspace pipeline first, unchanged). Tab base path and the Assessment Profile screen's own framing (kicker text, presence of a '← Tổng quan' button) now follow the account's real role namespace (/hv vs /ql) and real grant status instead of a bare routeRole check, so a manager-no-grant account never sees a manager-workspace button/label pointing at a workspace it doesn't have, and never sees a target picker (isManager for the picker/payload is now checklistManagerWorkspaceActive, not routeRole alone - payload never gains targetEmployeeCode for this account class; backend Batch 2 still 403s a forged target request as the real security boundary). Own QA pass caught and fixed a real regression introduced while simplifying title(): managerSectionFromLocation(path)==='assessment-profile' matches by path alone regardless of grant, so folding it into the new personal-experience branch would have silently dropped the 'Hồ sơ đánh giá · Quản lý' tab title for a manager WITH a grant - restored as a dedicated check ordered before the personal-experience branch, now covered by its own regression assertion. No backend/permission/API/score/history/Admin/violation code touched; SQL/preset untouched. Regression: scripts/test-checklist-assessment-profile-ui.js extended to assert the 4-helper matrix, the manager-no-grant Assessment Profile route reaching assessmentProfileHtml() directly, and the title() regression fix - 63 checks total. Full checklist suite (15 scripts, including 33/33 Batch1/2 backend) re-run clean.
